SELECT store_id, store_name, city, is_current
FROM dim_store
WHERE city = 'Tampere'
ORDER BY store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS customer_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE home_store_id IN (115, 116, 117, 136)
AND is_current = true

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS webshop_customers
FROM dim_member
WHERE home_store_id = 900
AND is_current = true

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS training_store_customers
FROM dim_member
WHERE home_store_id = 999
AND is_current = true

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS customer_count
FROM dim_member m
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.city = 'Tampere'
AND m.is_current = true
AND s.is_current = true
AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id
